piezas.titulo: Grammar in context: Family and close people
texto: Possession and family relationships: to show belonging, the particle «ของ» (khɔ̌ɔng, of) is used: [Object/Person] + «ของ» + [Owner]. Example: «แม่ของฉัน» (my mother, lit. mother of me). In everyday speech, «ของ» can be left out when the context is clear («แม่ฉัน»). To introduce a family member, «นี่คือ...» (this is...) is used: «นี่คือพ่อของฉัน» (This is my father). To say where someone is: [Person] + «อยู่» (to be at) + [Place]: «พ่ออยู่บ้าน» (Dad is at home).
